resolutions.researcher_notes: World Pipelines (Dec 28, 2018), publisher World Pipelines/Palladian: article states the Gemini Carthage Pipeline (Harrison/Panola Counties, TX, >1.2 Bcf/d) 'will be operational in the 1Q19' -- 1Q19 = Q1 2019, directly supporting StartYear1=2019 (prose-vs-numeric equivalence per brief). url_verifier's literal substring screen on '2019' FAILs because the page writes '1Q19', not the string '2019'; confirmed by reading the fetched page text directly, which quotes that exact phrase -- setting ok/contains_value true per the brief's instruction to override a substring false-negative when the document actually supports the value. Trace Midstream press release (Jan 31, 2020, PDF, verifier PASS on 'Gemini Carthage'): describes GCP as 'an existing 50-mile natural gas system in Harrison and Panola Counties, Texas, capable of delivering in excess of 1.2 billion cubic feet per day' as of Jan 31, 2020 -- corroborates the pipeline's existence, location, and capacity (matching World Pipelines' figures) but does not itself state a start year, so it confirms 'already operating before 2020' rather than independently pinning 2019. Kept as tier=medium/independent=false because only one publisher (World Pipelines) explicitly states the year; the Trace release is consistent but not an independent second statement of '2019'. geminimidstream.com/gcp (seed citation) no longer resolves in DNS (checked live -- ENOTFOUND); its 2019-10-17 Wayback capture (web.archive.org/web/20191017075227/https://www.geminimidstream.com/gcp) is a Wix client-rendered SPA whose saved HTML carries no server-rendered text (grepped for 'Carthage'/'1.2'/'operational', zero hits), so it could not be used as a citable source. rrc.texas.gov's general Natural Gas Tariffs and Rate Schedules page is a navigation/index surface (not a document naming this pipeline specifically) and was excluded per the no-navigation-surface rule.
